title: The referral system that runs while you sleep
summary: The AI-powered referral system that fills your pipeline on autopilot — 11 recipients

payload.subject: The referral system that runs while you sleep
payload.html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Most independent service businesses still ask for referrals by hand — a text here, a mention there — and most of the time, it just doesn't happen. 58% of small businesses now use generative AI, and referral requests are one of the easiest places to automate.


Here's the version worth building: the moment a job wraps, an AI follow-up fires automatically — a short, personal-sounding text or email asking for a referral, with a one-tap way to send it. If they don't respond, it follows up once more a few days later, no manual reminder needed. Any referral that comes in gets logged straight into your pipeline instead of getting lost in a text thread. AI-powered follow-up systems like this return $3.50 for every $1 invested, and 66% of small businesses using AI report saving $500–$2,000 a month on exactly this kind of manual work.


Want me to put together a custom AI + marketing plan for {{business_name}}? Book a quick discovery call.


Talk soon,
Dylan | Digigrowth
